exposure: Duration of stay at caesarean section wards (>5 days)
outcome: Opportunity cost of caesarean section delivery (days of work lost)
cohort: 270 mothers who underwent a caesarean section at a public tertiary care hospital in Hyderabad.
finding: The average unit cost for caesarean section delivery was 7647 rupees ($69), and the mean opportunity cost of days of work lost was 1334.02 rupees ($12.13).
